# OntoLogos v0.2.0

OWL file loading and profile detection.

## Install (Rust)

```toml
[dependencies]
ontologos-core = "0.2.0"
ontologos-parser = "0.2.0"
ontologos-profile = "0.2.0"
```

Docs:

- https://docs.rs/ontologos-core/0.2.0
- https://docs.rs/ontologos-parser/0.2.0
- https://docs.rs/ontologos-profile/0.2.0

## What ships in v0.2.0

- **Parser** — OWL/XML, RDF/XML, Turtle, OWL Functional Syntax via horned-owl
- **Profile detection** — EL / RL / QL / DL with hybrid diagnostics
- **CLI** — `ontologos profile <file>` (text and JSON)
- **Core** — new axiom variants: `SubClassOfExistential`, RL property declarations
- **Benchmarks** — Pizza + Family corpora, manifest integration tests

## Quick start

```bash
git clone https://github.com/eddiethedean/ontologos.git
cd ontologos
./benchmarks/scripts/download.sh
cargo build -p ontologos-cli --release
./target/release/ontologos profile benchmarks/data/pizza.owl
```

## Not yet available

- OWL classification / materialization / explanations (v0.3–v0.6)
- Full Python API (v0.9)

See [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/eddiethedean/ontologos/blob/v0.2.0/CHANGELOG.md) for the full list of changes.
